verdicts.reason: Documentation incorrectly adds a `data` positional argument to `receive_json`, but the method takes only `mode` and returns received data.
verdicts.suggested_doc_fix: Use `websocket.receive_json(mode="binary")` to receive JSON over binary data frames.

candidate.doc_text: Use `websocket.receive_json(data, mode="binary")` to receive JSON over binary data frames.
candidate.claim: method-call-signature: `websocket.receive_json(...)`: keyword 'mode' would also be filled positionally (multiple values); no package method 'receive_json' accepts it (e.g. WebSocketTestSession.receive_json at starlette/testclient.py:188)
